title: Signed counts equal reference positions
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $y$ be a finite Boolean word, let $t$ be a natural number, and let $i$ be a position coordinate. The signed value of the count pair at coordinate $i$ at time $t$ equals the reference position at coordinate $i$ of the configuration reached after $t$ steps on input $y$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
replaced: For every source machine, virtual input $y$, time $t$, and coordinate, the signed value of the stored count pair equals the reference position of the configuration reached at time $t$: the shifted clamped input position on the first coordinate and the signed work-head positions on the rest.
